name: @ably/embedded-server
description: PoC: embed an ably-server child process in a Node host app and reverse-proxy realtime (WebSocket) + REST to it on a dedicated port. Express and Fastify adapters.
//comment-packaging: In a real package the prebuilt binary would ship via optionalDependencies keyed by os/cpu (esbuild precedent), e.g. @ably/embedded-server-darwin-arm64 -> bin/ably-server. For this PoC the binary is built locally into ./bin and resolved from there.
